title: Selection Policies for Equal-Byte Mixed-Precision Quantization of Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28318v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can changing which matrices receive 2, 4, or 8 bits improve a small language model without increasing its parameter storage? I compare two parent-selection rules in the same genetic algorithm: a binary-tournament variant and an Alternis-inspired rule. A separate baseline samples repaired random allocations without crossover or mutation. All three use the same MLX affine quantizer, byte ceiling, initialization and candidate allowance within each study. An exploratory study on Qwen3.5-2B evaluates 90 allocations per run. The main study on Qwen3-1.7B evaluates 500 distinct allocations per run over 10 paired seeds. Against uniform four-bit, tournament reduces held-out next-token negative log-likelihood (NLL) by 0.0616 on AG News and 0.0152 on IMDb on average, improving all 10 seeds on each corpus at identical parameter storage. Alternis improves five seeds and ties five on AG News; on IMDb its mean gain is near zero. Random returns uniform f

translated_title: 小语言模型等字节混合精度量化的选择策略
translated_abstract: 在不增加参数存储的前提下，改变哪些矩阵被分配2、4或8比特能否提升小语言模型的性能？本文在同一遗传算法中比较了两种父代选择规则：二元锦标赛变体和受Alternis启发的规则。另一个独立的基线则通过采样经过修复的随机分配方案（不使用交叉或变异）进行对比。在每项研究中，三者均使用相同的MLX仿射量化器、字节上限、初始化方式和候选配额。在Qwen3.5-2B上的探索性研究每次运行评估90种分配方案。在Qwen3-1.7B上的主要研究在10个配对随机种子上每次运行评估500种不同的分配方案。与统一的四比特量化相比，锦标赛选择在AG News上平均降低0.0616、在IMDb上平均降低0.0152的留出集下一词元负对数似然（NLL），并在相同参数存储下于两个语料库上均改进了全部10个种子。Alternis在AG News上改进了五个种子、与五个种子持平；在IMDb上其平均增益接近于零。随机基线返回与均匀四比特相当的……
tldr: 在相同参数存储下，用遗传算法优化小语言模型各矩阵的混合精度位宽分配，其中二元锦标赛选择策略效果最佳，相比统一四比特量化能显著降低下一词元负对数似然，优于Alternis启发式规则和随机分配基线。
en_tdlr: Under identical parameter storage, using a genetic algorithm to optimize per-matrix mixed-precision bit allocation for small language models—with binary tournament selection proving most effective—reduces next-token NLL compared to uniform 4-bit quantization, outperforming an Alternis-inspired rule and a random-allocation baseline.
